meta.title: Normativa AR
meta.description: Semantic search over Argentine national legislation, with cited answers.

home.tagline: Semantic search over Argentine national legislation
home.intro: Ask in plain language and get an answer that cites the source regulation.
home.disclaimer: Not legal advice. Always check the official text.

status.heading: System status
status.updateFailed: The last update of the regulations failed {ago}: they may be out of date.
status.updateOverdue: The regulations were last updated {ago}: they may be out of date.
status.neverUpdated: No update of the regulations has run yet.

ask.label: Question
ask.placeholder: For example: what is the cap on pay for overtime services?
exampleQuestions: Which law approves the amendment to the tax treaty with France?
Additional pay for military service in Antarctica
ask.resting: {model} was not asked: it failed a moment ago.
ask.rewritten: The regulations found did not answer. Searched again as: “{query}”.
ask.rewrittenNothing: The new search found nothing different.

outcome.not_in_sources: The regulations found do not answer the question. Look at the sources, or try other words.
outcome.uncited: This answer cites no source: it cannot be checked.
outcome.no_sources: No regulation is close to the question. Try other words.

ask.unknownCitation: Source {n} does not exist: the model cited it by mistake.

amount.other_source: This amount is in another of the sources, not in the one cited.
amount.not_found: This amount is in none of the sources.

amountsWarning.one: One amount does not match the source it cites. It is marked in the text.
amountsWarning.other: {count} amounts do not match the sources they cite. They are marked in the text.

failure.invalid: The question is not valid: it must be 3 to 500 characters long.
failure.rateLimitedClient: You asked many questions in the last minute. Try again in {seconds} s.
failure.rateLimitedTotal: The service is answering many questions. Try again in {seconds} s.
failure.searchUnavailable: Search is not available right now.
failure.model: No model could answer: the last one {reason}. The regulations found are below.
failure.network: The answer could not be completed. Check the connection and try again.

source.abstractOnly: Abstract only: the full text is not published.
source.earlier: Earlier regulations with nearly the same text:
